if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Character = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character 
local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

function FireProximityPrompt() 
    for _, ProximityPrompt in ipairs(game:GetService("Workspace"):GetDescendants()) do
        if ProximityPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then 
            fireproximityprompt(ProximityPrompt) 
        end 
    end 
end

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out) 
local tweenInfo2 = TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

function TweenTeleport(type, cframe, check, check2) 
    TweenService:Create(HumanoidRootPart, type, {CFrame = cframe}):Play() 
    if type == tweenInfo then wait(0.81) elseif type == tweenInfo2 then wait(5.1) end
    if check == true then FireProximityPrompt() end 
    if check2 == false then wait(0.3) elseif check2 == true then wait(4) end 
end
